summary: iter89 frontend verification PASSED. Photo album rename + RSVPs-closed lockdown both work end-to-end on the deployed preview URL. (F1) Editing a CUSTOM album ('Beta Line') via the gear icon now opens a dialog with the new Title input prefilled with current name; saving with new title 'Iter89 UI Rename {ts}' shows the 'Renamed to ...' toast, updates the card data-testid, persists via GET /api/photos/albums, and reopens prefilled with the new value. (F1b) Editing a DEFAULT album ('Commitment Ceremony 2025') shows the Title input disabled with the yellow note 'Default albums cannot be renamed.' (F2) Admin → Events tab → edit a fresh test event renders the orange 'Close RSVPs (admins-only mode)' toggle (data-testid=event-rsvps-closed-toggle) below the cancelled toggle; flipping ON + Save persists rsvps_closed=true. (F2b) /events/{id} as admin shows the amber-bordered event-rsvps-closed-notice ('🔒 RSVPs are closed for this event.') AND the admin RSVP/Manage buttons remain visible (no rsvp-btn-closed for admin). (F3) Member login at /events/{id} sees the amber notice plus a disabled grey 'rsvp-btn-closed' reading '🔒 RSVPs are closed — contact an admin'; rsvp-btn / PaidEventCheckout / MemberTicketPicker / GuestManager are all suppressed. (F4) Admin clicks 'RSVP a member + guests', selects Riley Chen, clicks 'Confirm RSVP' — RSVP succeeds and Riley appears in the Going list. (F5) Re-opening RSVPs from /admin removes the amber notice and restores the normal RSVP + GuestManager UI. Cleanup: test event deleted (DELETE /api/events/{id} → 200) and album reverted to 'Beta Line'.

critical_code_review_comments: EventDetail.jsx logic at L57 `rsvpsLocked = event.cancelled || (event.rsvps_closed && !isAdmin)` is correct — admins remain unlocked even when rsvps_closed=true, while members see the lockdown.

Photos.jsx EditAlbumDialog correctly disables the name input + shows the amber note when album.is_default=true; PUT payload only includes `name` when nameChanged is true so default albums can still update category without sending a name field.
Backend AlbumUpdateIn + rsvp_event / update_rsvp_guests gating already covered by pytest test_iteration89_album_rename_and_rsvp_lockdown.py (10/10 pass per main-agent context).
